ColumnStats.description: Numeric planner statistics only — never value samples (T1.11).
ColumnStats.title: ColumnStats

NodeMetrics.description: Derived, deterministic numbers. None means "not measurable from this plan", never zero.
NodeMetrics.title: NodeMetrics

PlanNode.description: A node of an `EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON)` plan. Times are per loop, as PostgreSQL reports.
PlanNode.title: PlanNode

QueryFingerprint.description: Groups similar queries. Metadata only, never artifact identity (REPLAY_ENGINE §2.2).
QueryFingerprint.title: QueryFingerprint

get.description: Exact stored bytes, re-verified against the digest on read.
Liveness only: the process is up.
Readiness: metadata DB reachable and migrated to head (API_DESIGN §2).

post.description:
Idempotent (API_DESIGN §4): queued/awaiting_approval stop at once; a running run moves
to cancelling and the worker stops at its next safe point.

get.description: Which provider/model runs use, and whether a key is configured. Never the key.
